package main

import (
	"flag"
)

func main() {
	flag.Bool("Debug", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("v", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("a/b", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("-x", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("日本", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("a b", false, "u")
	flag.Bool(".dot", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("1abc", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("ok-name", false, "u")
	flag.Bool("x.y_z-1", false, "u")
	flag.Parse()
}
